name: Algebraic Invariant and Weighted Tie-Break
description: Replaces the direct logical inequality (different shift codes) with a symmetric quadratic Diophantine equation whose only solutions on the domain {1, 2} are the pairs (1, 2) and (2, 1). Replaces the "lexicographically smallest" tie-break rule with the minimization of an exponentially decaying weighted sum, which is mathematically identical to lexicographical order but looks like a global numerical optimization objective.
